text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Maids and housekeeping services...
The average hourly rate is around...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, it makes sense it'd cost that much...
*sigh*... My paycheck, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, goal re-evaluation compleeete!
...Wait for me, you two.
Big sis is definitely going to pull this off!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaah!!

Summer camp reached the halfway mark.
We spent our days training with
a new summer camp regimen, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... haa...!
Phew~ How was that time?!
I compare the numbers on the stopwatch with the records compiling her past times.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Urk... I knew it?
I did feel like I had way too much energy left over.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it makes me feel all restless.
I know I have to hold back, but that's different from slacking off, right?

The "efficient" running style demanded of her after the Derby.
Developing that is no easy task.
Simply put, it's a full-throttle running style constantly aiming to break records. But right now, we need an appropriate pace, not maximum speed.
And that's not something you can pull off with the pedal to the metal. All of a sudden, running requires delicate control.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
……Mgggh……
I know it in my head, but……
choice_data_list: ...Is the new running style not clicking?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Still, this is no time to be whining “No way~!”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If I collapse over every single thing,
I won't be able to get anything done.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to cause extra worry anymore,
like having to go to the hospital...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to try one more time!
I'll keep running as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's okay—'cause I'm the big sister!!
After finishing training, the Umamusume spent their break however they pleased.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayyy☆ Summer fest means gettin' the vibes maxed all the way up! Right, Palmer-chin!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Since it's a training camp and all,
let's give it everything we've got, both in training and fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Regarding tomorrow's match race...
I would like to start at 3000m. Would that be alright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! I was thinking I wanted
to run with you before the Kikuka Sho too!

Some rested to recharge their energy,
while others prepared for tomorrow's training.
Among them, Ines Fujin—

text_block_list.name: Beach Hut Owner
text_block_list.text:
Then could you wipe down the swim rings that were returned
and hang them out to dry?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Right here! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha, it's Trainer.
You found me~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, don't worry.
I already got permission from the academy for my part-time job."
choice_data_list: Haven't your part-time shifts been piling up lately?
Haven't your part-time shifts been piling up lately?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I don't get tired
as easily as before, after all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I could send more money back home!
I can't let my little sister worry about unnecessary things!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... When I went back home the other day,
I had a little fight.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Talking so big like a full-grown adult.
There's no need to worry about the family—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm the one who's gonna protect their dreams.
The next day, as I was preparing for training with Ines Fujin—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOOOOOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

The shouts of two Umamusume echo across the beach
as clouds of sand kick up simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hmm. With the Kikuka Sho just ahead, Mejiro Ryan's edge seems to have sharpened quite a bit~.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the Mejiro family's prized prodigy shouldn't be underestimated either.
Look, see for yourself."

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: McQueen isn't out of breath at all. If she's entering the Kikuka Sho like that, I might need to rethink my strategy...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ryan-chan's gotten even faster...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, watch me!
Today's the day I master my new running style!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaah!!

Ines Fujin starts to run.
Her speed rapidly increases, faster and faster—
choice_data_list: (...At this rate, the pace is too fast.)

text_block_list.text:
Her new, efficient running form just wasn't clicking.
With so little time left before the Kikuka Sho, her growing anxiety seemed to be reflecting in her speed.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
How... did I do...?
choice_data_list: ...Why don't you take a little breather?
...Why don't we take a little breather?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Let's eat a meal that'll give us strength!
Let's refresh ourselves! At a waterfall!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...*nibble*. *munch*.
*nom*...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? I'm still eating, though...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm stuffed!
Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I got waaaay more than enough rest!
So can we do one more training session?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to do everything I can beforehand!
Regretting and asking myself 'Why didn't I do it back then?' hurts so much worse, you know?

The end of the summer training camp
was already just around the corner.
(RUUUUMBLE!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Such a powerful sound. Mingled with the birds chirping, it's so soothing~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...So, how much longer
do I need to stare at this waterfall?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, take a deep breath in.
Ready, and... Inhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, breathe out~.
Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Has that calmed you down a bit?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm good. It was a nice change of pace for me too.
Your invite came at just the right time, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I gotta pull myself together too!
Both as a big sister and as an Umamusume!
